name: Conditional Payment Method for WooCommerce
author: Repon Hossain

sections.description:
Conditional Payment Method for WooCommerce is an essential plugin for store managers looking to fully control payment options at checkout. With this plugin, you can set up WooCommerce different payment methods for different products, showing or hiding specific options based on cart contents, customer type, order history, and much more.

Using WooCommerce disable payment method for specific product functionality, you can prevent incompatible or high-risk payment methods from appearing when certain items are added to the cart. Additionally, with WooCommerce payment methods by country, the plugin allows you to display payment options based on the customer’s location, ensuring customers see only the relevant methods available in their region.

This plugin also offers Conditional payment methods for WooCommerce by allowing you to configure rules that match your business needs. By dynamically managing WooCommerce Conditional payment gateways and using WooCommerce payment conditions, you can ensure that only appropriate payment options appear for each order. This flexibility helps streamline the checkout experience, providing a secure and efficient way to meet your customers’ needs.

Whether you need to disable payment methods based on cart total, weight, or specific products, Conditional Payment Method for WooCommerce delivers the tools to customize your store’s payment options, making checkout more reliable and tailored to each customer.

Key Features of Conditional Payment Method for WooCommerce:

  • Flexible Conditional Payment Methods for WooCommerce: Hide or enable payment methods based on diverse conditions.
  • Disable Payment Methods: Customize payment options per product, category, or total cart quantity, allowing unique payment flows.
  • WooCommerce Conditional Payment Gateways: Choose which payment gateways appear at checkout, based on specified conditions.
  • Dynamic WooCommerce Payment Conditions: Set rules that control payment options, providing flexibility across different purchasing scenarios.
  • WooCommerce Different Payment Methods for Different Products: Tailor payment methods to individual products or categories.
  • WooCommerce Payment Methods by Location: Hide or show payment methods based on billing and shipping addresses.
  • Date-Based Payment Availability: Control payment options seasonally or for specific date ranges.

Common Use Cases

  • Restrict payment options for orders under a minimum amount or above a certain cart quantity.
  • Hide specific payment gateways when certain products or categories are in the cart.
  • Location-based payment methods to show preferred payment gateways by country, state, or city.
  • Role-specific payment options that allow different payment methods for wholesalers, subscribers, or retail customers.
  • Date-based restrictions for seasonal payment offers or time-sensitive payment methods.

Support & Documentation

For any issues or questions, please reach out through the support forum.
sections.faq:
Can I restrict payment methods based on cart weight?

Yes, you can hide or enable payment methods based on the total weight of items in the cart.

Can I disable a payment method for orders below a specific amount?

Absolutely! Set a condition for the minimum cart subtotal required for the payment option to appear.

How do I hide payment method for certain regions?

You can use the shipping or billing address condition to restrict for specific locations or countries.
